fields.label: Bot token (Developer Portal → Bot → Reset Token)

setup.help: Create an application on Discord's Developer Portal, open its Bot page, turn on the Server Members and Message Content intents, then press Reset Token and paste the token here. Invite the bot to your server and drag its role above any role you want it to hand out.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify the bot token by calling GET /users/@me. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.

bot.getMe.title: Get Bot User
bot.getMe.description: Return the bot's own user (id, username). Call once per run so later steps can recognise the bot's own messages and skip them.

guild.get.title: Get Server
guild.get.description: Fetch a server (guild) by id with approximate member and presence counts.

channels.list.title: List Channels
channels.list.description: List every channel and category in a server, with id, name, type (0 text, 2 voice, 4 category, 15 forum) and parent_id. Use it to resolve a channel name to its id.

channels.get.title: Get Channel
channels.get.description: Fetch one channel or thread by id.

channels.create.title: Create Channel
channels.create.description: Create a channel in a server. type 0 is a text channel (default), 2 voice, 4 category, 15 forum. Give parentId to place it under a category.

name.description: Channel name, 1-100 characters, lowercase with dashes for text channels.

parentId.description: Category channel id to nest under.

reason.description: Audit-log reason shown to server admins.

channels.update.title: Update Channel
channels.update.description: Rename a channel, change its topic, or move it under a category. Only the fields supplied change.

parentId.description: Category channel id to move under.

channels.delete.title: Delete Channel
channels.delete.description: Delete a channel or thread for good, with every message in it. Cannot be undone.

messages.list.title: List Messages
messages.list.description: Read a channel's or thread's recent messages, newest first (up to 100). Supply at most one of before, after, around (message ids). Each message carries author.id and author.bot; skip your own and other bots' messages when deciding what to answer.

before.description: Only messages before this message id.

after.description: Only messages after this message id.

messages.send.title: Send Message
messages.send.description: Post a new message to a channel or thread (up to 2000 characters). To answer a specific message use Reply instead, so members can see what you are answering.

content.description: Message text, up to 2000 characters. Mention a user with <@userId>, a channel with <#channelId>.

messages.reply.title: Reply to Message
messages.reply.description: Reply to one message in its channel or thread, quoting it. Use this to answer a member's question; your reply is what marks the question as handled.

channelId.description: The channel or thread id the message is in.

messages.edit.title: Edit Message
messages.edit.description: Change the text of a message the bot sent.

messages.delete.title: Delete Message
messages.delete.description: Remove one message from a channel. Give a reason; it appears in the server's audit log. Report the deletion in the mod-log channel afterwards.

reason.description: Audit-log reason, e.g. the rule broken.

messages.bulkDelete.title: Bulk Delete Messages
messages.bulkDelete.description: Delete 2 to 100 messages at once by id. Messages older than two weeks are rejected by Discord. Cannot be undone.

messages.pin.title: Pin Message
messages.pin.description: Pin a message in its channel (up to 50 pins per channel).

messages.unpin.title: Unpin Message
messages.unpin.description: Unpin a message in its channel.

messages.listPinned.title: List Pinned Messages
messages.listPinned.description: List the messages pinned in a channel. Pins are often the channel's own FAQ; read them before answering.

threads.create.title: Create Thread
threads.create.description: Start a public thread in a text channel, not attached to a message. Use Create Thread From Message to discuss a specific message.

autoArchiveMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before archiving: 60, 1440, 4320 or 10080.

threads.createFromMessage.title: Create Thread From Message
threads.createFromMessage.description: Start a thread under one message, keeping a longer answer out of the main channel.

channelId.description: The channel id the message is in.

threads.join.title: Join Thread
threads.join.description: Add the bot to a thread so it receives and can post there.

threads.leave.title: Leave Thread
threads.leave.description: Remove the bot from a thread.

threads.addMember.title: Add Thread Member
threads.addMember.description: Add a member to a thread.

threads.listActive.title: List Active Threads
threads.listActive.description: List every unarchived thread in a server.

threads.listArchived.title: List Archived Threads
threads.listArchived.description: List a channel's archived public threads, newest first.

before.description: ISO8601 timestamp; only threads archived before it.

reactions.add.title: Add Reaction
reactions.add.description: React to a message as the bot. emoji is the unicode character (👍) or a custom emoji as name:id.

emoji.description: Unicode emoji or name:id for a custom emoji.

reactions.remove.title: Remove Own Reaction
reactions.remove.description: Remove the bot's reaction from a message.

reactions.removeUser.title: Remove a User's Reaction
reactions.removeUser.description: Remove one member's reaction from a message (moderation).

reactions.clear.title: Clear Reactions
reactions.clear.description: Remove every reaction from a message.

reactions.list.title: List Reactions
reactions.list.description: List the users who reacted to a message with one emoji.

members.list.title: List Members
members.list.description: List a server's members in user-id order with their roles and joined_at. Requires the Server Members privileged intent on the bot. Page with after (the last user id seen). A member without the welcomed role has not been onboarded yet.

after.description: User id cursor; members with a higher id follow.

members.search.title: Search Members
members.search.description: Find members whose username or nickname starts with a string.

members.get.title: Get Member
members.get.description: Fetch one member of a server: user, nick, roles, joined_at, communication_disabled_until.

users.get.title: Get User
users.get.description: Fetch a Discord user by id.

members.kick.title: Kick Member
members.kick.description: Remove a member from the server. They can rejoin with an invite. Give the rule broken as the reason.

members.timeout.title: Time Out Member
members.timeout.description: Mute a member until an ISO8601 time (at most 28 days ahead). Reversible with Clear Timeout. Give the rule broken as the reason.

until.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the timeout ends.

members.addRole.title: Add Role to Member
members.addRole.description: Give a member a role, e.g. the welcomed role after onboarding. The bot's own role must sit above the role given.

members.removeRole.title: Remove Role from Member
members.removeRole.description: Take a role away from a member.

roles.list.title: List Roles
roles.list.description: List a server's roles with id, name, position and permissions. Use it to resolve a role name to its id.

roles.create.title: Create Role
roles.create.description: Create a role. color is an integer RGB value; permissions is a permission bitfield as a string.

hoist.description: Show members separately in the sidebar.

permissions.description: Permission bitfield as a decimal string.

roles.update.title: Update Role
roles.update.description: Change a role's name, colour, hoist, mentionable or permissions. Only supplied fields change.

roles.delete.title: Delete Role
roles.delete.description: Delete a role from the server. Members lose it immediately. Cannot be undone.

bans.list.title: List Bans
bans.list.description: List banned users with the reason recorded for each.

bans.create.title: Ban Member
bans.create.description: Ban a user from the server, optionally deleting their recent messages. A person must approve this; post the case to the mod-log first.

deleteMessageSeconds.description: Delete the user's messages from the last N seconds (0-604800).

invites.list.title: List Invites
invites.list.description: List a server's active invite links with their code, channel, inviter and uses.

invites.revoke.title: Revoke Invite
invites.revoke.description: Delete an invite link so it stops working.

code.description: The invite code (the part after discord.gg/).

dm.open.title: Open Direct Message
dm.open.description: Open (or return) the bot's DM channel with a user. Then use Send Message with the returned channel id. Members who block DMs from server members cannot be reached this way.

events.list.title: List Scheduled Events
events.list.description: List a server's scheduled events with how many members are interested.

events.createExternal.title: Create External Event
events.createExternal.description: Schedule an event that happens somewhere other than a voice channel (a link or a place). Needs a start, an end and a location.

location.description: Where it happens: a URL or an address, up to 100 characters.

events.createVoice.title: Create Voice Channel Event
events.createVoice.description: Schedule an event held in one of the server's voice channels (entity_type 2). A stage-channel event needs entity_type 1, which this connector does not offer.

channelId.description: The voice or stage channel id.

events.update.title: Update Scheduled Event
events.update.description: Change an event's name, description, times or status (1 scheduled, 2 active, 3 completed, 4 cancelled). Only supplied fields change.

events.delete.title: Delete Scheduled Event
events.delete.description: Remove an event from the server. Interested members are not told. Prefer Update with status 4 (cancelled) so they are.

emojis.list.title: List Custom Emojis
emojis.list.description: List the server's custom emojis (name and id); react with them as name:id.

guilds.list.title: List bot guilds
guilds.list.description: List guilds joined by the bot. Pass the last returned guild ID as after to fetch the next page; stop on an empty page.

after.description: Return guilds after this guild ID.

id.description: Provider resource ID, preserved as a string.

messages.get.title: Get message
messages.get.description: Read one accessible channel message. Content availability depends on bot permissions and intents.

id.description: Provider resource ID, preserved as a string.

channel_id.description: Provider resource ID, preserved as a string.

content.description: Message text; may be empty when access to content is restricted.

messages.create.title: Create text message
messages.create.description: Send a text-only bot message; requires SEND_MESSAGES. Mentions are suppressed. Content limit is 2000 characters.

content.description: Non-empty message text, up to 2000 characters.

id.description: Provider resource ID, preserved as a string.

channel_id.description: Provider resource ID, preserved as a string.

content.description: Message text; may be empty when access to content is restricted.

normalized.post.create.title: Create normalized text post
normalized.post.create.description: Publish text and return the versioned appcall Post model. Send a text-only bot message; requires SEND_MESSAGES. Mentions are suppressed. Content limit is 2000 characters.

text.description: Non-empty message text, up to 2000 characters.
